subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which core contract should own durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision: the task ledger, a new subagent lifecycle ledger, or the broader metadata-audit foundation?
rationale: The source has enough signals and internal controls for several plausible designs, but the public API, persistence owner, retention, authorization, and redaction semantics need maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Design shared audit foundation first
options.body: Use the metadata-audit foundation as the canonical durable ledger, then add subagent-specific receipt and supervision views on top.

options.title: Add subagent-specific ledger
options.body: Create a dedicated subagent lifecycle table and API now, accepting a narrower but potentially parallel audit source of truth.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Decline durable lifecycle receipts for now and continue using task/subagent summaries plus internal controls.

recommendation.title: Design shared audit foundation first
recommendation.body: Use the metadata-audit foundation as the canonical durable ledger, then add subagent-specific receipt and supervision views on top.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears across recent state, task, gateway protocol, and subagent-control history and owns the related metadata-audit direction.
